summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of an upsized $650 million private offering of 7.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 at 99.479% of par. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The notes are secured by substantially all assets except aircraft, engines, and real property. Issuance is expected June 24, 2026. There are no M&A, shareholder return, or restructuring elements. This filing is a standard current report on a financing event and does not fall into any special-situations category.
